adjudication.rationale: In the new API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts` the handler imports `appStoreMetadata` (`import { appStoreMetadata } from "@calcom/app-store/appStoreMetaData";`) and then indexes it by `app.slug` to obtain `slug`/`type`. This is a serverless/API-route hot path, and importing a full metadata barrel/object just to look up one entry can unnecessarily increase module load time and memory footprint (potentially affecting cold starts). The diff shows the full-object import and single-entry usage, so the concern is diff-grounded, though the exact bundle/cold-start impact isn’t directly measurable from the diff alone.
